text: My daily routine starts early in the morning. I usually wake up at seven o'clock, brush my teeth, and have a quick breakfast. Then I go to work at nine and stay in the office until five in the evening. After work, I like to exercise for about an hour, either running in the park or going to the gym. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch some TV, or read a book before going to bed. I try to follow the same schedule every day because consistency helps me stay healthy, organized, and stress-free.
